tool_workflow.prompt_or_acquisition_path: Create a clean review contact sheet of five separate prototype-grade 2D platformer asset candidates: player character, floor/platform tile, obstacle/blocker, goal marker, and timer/HUD treatment. Style: simple readable indie-game prototype art, flat-shaded, crisp silhouettes, friendly but not final, suitable for a tiny side-view platformer greybox replacement test. Composition: one horizontal row of five clearly separated assets, equal spacing, each asset isolated with generous padding. No labels, no text, no UI explanation. Constraints: no enemies, no items, no score, no weapon, no dash/attack/aim implication, no text, no watermark, no final polished production style, no complex background.

candidates.prompt_or_acquisition_path: Prompt requested a small readable rounded rectangle-like adventurer silhouette in cool color.
candidates.generation_or_edit_parameters: single generated contact sheet; exact model parameters not exposed
candidates.license_or_rights_note: Generated by built-in image generation workflow for internal prototype review. Production or public release use requires separate rights review.

candidates.implementation_handoff_note: Implementation should not import this RGB crop directly as final sprite. If approved, create a transparent PNG in a later authorized implementation or asset-prep Work Package.

manifest_limits: This manifest supports prototype review only.
The CSV files are the human review/edit surface for scalable asset review; JSON remains the agent-readable structured record.
The individual candidate crops are review units, but they are not ready for direct Godot import because they are RGB crops without transparency.
The generated sheet is supplementary evidence only, not the primary review unit.
No candidate is approved for production or public release use.
BK/Human Creative Owner review is still required before implementation planning.
